backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing user profiles with access control and storing contact form submissions, including admin-only retrieval.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping pricing‑removal changes to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file, including pages, components, hooks, and config.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based theme variables and color definitions for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML document loading fonts, metadata, favicon, and the React entry script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router routes for all pages and wraps the app with ThemeProvider.
frontend/src/components/contact/InquiryF: Contact form component with validation and submission logic that sends inquiries to the backend.
frontend/src/components/gallery/GalleryG: Responsive image grid that displays gallery images and notifies parent on image clicks.
frontend/src/components/gallery/GalleryL: Modal lightbox with keyboard navigation, next/previous controls, close handling, and image display.
frontend/src/components/site/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with branding, navigation links, contact info, social icons, and dynamic year attribution.
Provides the main site layout wrapper including top navigation, page content, and footer.
frontend/src/components/site/TopNav.tsx: Implements a responsive navigation bar with logo, links, mobile menu, and active‑route styling.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor based on the user's identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication, login flow, and stored identity loading.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines a mutation hook to submit contact inquiries through the backend actor and invalidate related queries.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and custom light/dark theme CSS variables for the application.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with query client and Internet Identity provider setup.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders the About page with company story, mission highlights, and feature cards.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Renders a contact page with cards showing contact details and an inquiry form.
frontend/src/pages/GalleryPage.tsx: Displays a gallery grid of images with a lightbox for viewing and navigating photos.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Provides the homepage layout with a hero section, feature highlights, and navigation links.
frontend/src/pages/PricingPage.tsx: Shows a pricing intro with a quote request card and contact method cards.
frontend/src/pages/ServicesPage.tsx: Lists available car accessory installation services in a grid with icons and descriptions.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session-based parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, animations, typography, container settings, and plugins.
project_state.json: Defines the project state, existing features, and pending feature requests related to removing pricing content.
